hotels.title: Palatial San Diego Coastal Charm with Michelin-Starred Dining, Golf Course & Four Pools
hotels.description: Surrounded by lush landscapes and Mediterranean-inspired architecture, the five-star Fairmont Grand Del Mar is an oasis of luxury, featuring a world-class spa, an award-winning golf course and four pools. Enjoy Michelin-starred dining at Addison Restaurant and laid-back Italian fare at Cent' Anni Café. Tucked away in the rolling hills of Northern San Diego, you're a short hop from sweeping coastline views at La Jolla, the raw wilderness of Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve and the historic Old Town San Diego. Imbued with charm and elegance, Fairmont Grand Del Mar sits cradled among the undulating hills of the Carmel Valley.

hotels.vendor_name: Hotel Indigo San Diego Del Mar
hotels.title: Boutique San Diego Coastal Escape with Ocean Views
hotels.description: Experience the coastal charm of Southern California with a stay at Hotel Indigo San Diego Del Mar, an IHG Hotel. This boutique retreat offers a refreshing blend of beachside relaxation and vibrant city life. Spend your days strolling along the pristine beaches, or indulging in the regions fresh seafood at local eateries. Back at the hotel, unwind in the tranquil Spa NA’MARA, take a dip in the pool, or enjoy a cocktail at the Ocean View Bar & Grill while gazing out at the coastal landscape.

hotels.title: Relaxed Bayside California Retreat next to SeaWorld San Diego
hotels.description: Indulge in Southern California beachside glamour in the fun-filled Paradise Point Resort & Spa, the closest resort to the iconic SeaWorld San Diego. You'll find everything you could want for a fun-filled family holiday here, with five swimming pools, a tranquil spa, delicious coastal cuisine, and plenty of island recreation options for you to explore. Venture out for a dip in the resort's private lake or nearby beaches, or discover San Diego's top attractions within walking distance.
